mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library. With the first quarter moon shining, look up at 4:09 AM to spot the International Space Station crossing from the south southwest near Belleville toward the east northeast over Fitchburg and Madison.

In city news, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving along as crews focus on underground utility work between Nine Mound Road and Todd Street. Meanwhile, the city is continuing its commitment to a connected community through a long-term plan to install sidewalks and multi-use paths on streets throughout Verona to improve accessibility and safety.

There is plenty to do in town today, starting with the Epic Systems User Group Meeting, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and the Concerts in the Park series. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow or head to the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.
In a report from last Friday, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for her first offence of O W I after an officer observed her vehicle swerving and ultimately found her passed out behind the wheel.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
